facts.label: Planos e lugares
facts.sub: Use going to para planos e there is/are para dizer o que existe no lugar: I’m going to bring sandwiches. There are two tables.

facts.label: Planos
facts.sub: Use am/is/are going to + verbo base para planos: I’m going to bring fruit. We’re going to sit on a blanket. Para perguntar: Are you going to bring a ball?

facts.label: Há
facts.sub: Use there is com uma coisa: There is a shop at the gate. Use there are com várias: There are two tables. Pergunte Is there a shop? Are there any tables?

pages.title: A big park · 1/3
paragraphs: It is Sunday morning at a big park in Montreal. The grass is green and the sky is blue. Noel waits at the park gate. His friend Luisa comes with a basket. They are going to have a picnic. Noel asks about the plan.
“Hi, Luisa! Are you ready for the picnic?” says Noel. “Yes! I’m going to bring sandwiches and fruit.” says Luisa. “Great. There is a nice place under the big tree.” says Noel.
